Class Additive (C : Category) := { additive_zero : @ZeroObject C; additive_preadditive : @Preadditive C; additive_biproducts : @HasBiproducts C additive_zero; pneg {x y} : (x ~> y) -> (x ~> y); padd_pneg (f : x ~> y) : padd f (pneg f) ≈ pzero }

Theorem factorization_unique (F1 F2 : Factorization f E M) : ∃ i : fact_mid F1 ≅ fact_mid F2, (to i ∘ fact_e F1 ≈ fact_e F2) ∧ (fact_m F2 ∘ to i ≈ fact_m F1). (+ factorization_lift_unique makes the comparison unique)
Definition Abelian_OFS : OFS (@EpiClass C)(@MonoClass C) := {| ofs_factor := abelian_factorization; ofs_orth := abelian_epi_mono_ortho; ... |}

statement_record.book: Every arrow f in an abelian category factors as f = m e with m monic, e epi, m = ker(coker f), e = coker(ker f). The factorization is FUNCTORIAL: for a morphism ⟨g,h⟩ : f→f' (commutative square) there is a unique k with e'g = ke and m'k = hm; in particular any two monic-epi factorizations of f are isomorphic by a unique iso.
statement_record.intree: abelian_epi_mono_factorization gives f = m∘e with m = abelian_image f = ker(coker f) monic and e = abelian_image_med f epic (image_mediator_epic, Abelian.v:353). Uniqueness up to unique iso: factorization_unique (iso commuting with both legs) + factorization_lift_unique (the comparison is unique). Packaged as Abelian_OFS.
